statechart.datamodel:
/* The chart owns the proposal that gives a later affirm or deny event its referent. This is deliberately small: it is tutorial interaction state, not a durable deployment record. */ :- dynamic pending_proposal/3.
confident(choice(_, _, Confidence)) :- Confidence >= 0.70. has_intent(choice(Intent, _, _), Intent).
remember_proposal(Ref, Text, observation(Intent, _, _, _)) :- retractall(pending_proposal(_, _, _)), assertz(pending_proposal(Ref, Text, Intent)).
take_proposal(proposal(Ref, Text, Intent)) :- retract(pending_proposal(Ref, Text, Intent)).
report(From, Ref, Text, Observation, State, Transition, Action, Reply) :- From ! demo_reply(Ref, report(Text, Observation, state(State), transition(Transition), action(Action), Reply)).

state.go: report(From, Ref, Text, unavailable(Error), idle, none, retry_later, "Jev is unavailable; no state change was made.")
report(From, Ref, Text, Observation, idle, none, clarify, "I am not confident enough to act. Please rephrase.")
remember_proposal(Ref, Text, Observation), report(From, Ref, Text, Observation, idle, idle-awaiting_confirmation, ask_confirmation, "Deployment is prepared. Say yes to confirm or no to cancel.")
report(From, Ref, Text, Observation, idle, none, show_status, "No deployment is currently awaiting confirmation.")
report(From, Ref, Text, Observation, idle, none, explain_context, "Yes to what? No deployment is awaiting confirmation.")
report(From, Ref, Text, Observation, idle, none, clarify, "Tell me if you want to prepare a deployment.")
report(From, Ref, Text, unavailable(Error), awaiting_confirmation, none, retry_later, "Jev is unavailable; the pending deployment remains unchanged.")
report(From, Ref, Text, Observation, awaiting_confirmation, none, clarify, "I could not confidently interpret that; please say yes or no.")

take_proposal(Proposal), report(From, Ref, Text, Observation, awaiting_confirmation, awaiting_confirmation-idle, simulate_deploy(Proposal), "Confirmed. The demonstrator records the deployment action.")
take_proposal(Proposal), report(From, Ref, Text, Observation, awaiting_confirmation, awaiting_confirmation-idle, cancel(Proposal), "Cancelled. No deployment action was recorded.")
report(From, Ref, Text, Observation, awaiting_confirmation, none, ask_confirmation, "A deployment is pending; please say yes or no.")
